FN-YFKI666-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 180
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility & Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/17/2024
Senate Bill 180 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Plumbers and Gas
Fitters Examining Board Fund by $3,850 per meeting of the board to increase board member
compensation from $200 per day to $750 per day, pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
Further, this bill would decrease receipts in the Fund by an estimated minimum of $5,600
annually to transfer from the Fund $0.33 from each certification and registration fee collected by
the board during the fiscal year, to the Alabama Home Builders Foundation to be used in the
manner provided by this bill.
Page 1
